common.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.login_subtitle: Use your email to access the workspace.

onboarding.welcome_subtitle: Three quick steps so the AI can write like your brand would.
onboarding.step_url_title: What's your store or brand website?
onboarding.step_url_subtitle: The AI will read everything public and draft your first brand DNA.
onboarding.step_dna_title: We read your brand. Here's what we learned:
onboarding.step_qa_title: Tell us more about your audience
onboarding.step_qa_subtitle: These answers feed every piece of copy from here on.
onboarding.step_done_subtitle: Your identity is saved and available as context in every generation.
onboarding.qa_publico_alvo_placeholder: E.g. busy professionals who value self-care…
onboarding.qa_interesses_label: 3 interests that connect your brand to your audience

dashboard.description: Your brand's starting point. The AI already has your DNA — just ask.
dashboard.empty_description: The AI combines your brand DNA with a style + framework and returns ready-to-use variations.
dashboard.hero_sub: Generate copy with your brand DNA in seconds — pick a channel and AI writes it.

generate.title: Multichannel generator
generate.description: Pick the content, the style and the brief — the AI writes variations with your brand DNA.
generate.step1_title: What do you want to create?
generate.step1_sub: Pick the content format. The AI adapts it with your brand DNA.
generate.step2_sub: Optional. Each style is a legendary copywriter with their own signature.
generate.let_ai_choose_sub: Auto — best style for the format
generate.advanced_hint: Structures used by professional copywriters (AIDA, PAS…). Leave it on Auto if you're unsure — the AI picks the best one for the format.
generate.step3_sub: The more specific, the better the copy.
generate.writing_variations: Writing {count} {count, plural, one {variation} other {variations}} based on your DNA…
generate.error_no_variations: The AI returned no variations. Refine the brief and try again.
generate.error_ai_failed: The AI didn't respond just now. Try again in a moment.
generate.error_feature_locked: This feature isn't in your current plan.
generate.error_cap_reached: You've reached your monthly AI usage limit.
generate.error_generic: Couldn't generate right now. Please try again.

copy.title: Copy library
copy.description: Versions with history, status and angles. Everything the AI generated and you approved.
copy.empty_description: Generate your first piece in the generator. Each saved variation becomes a copy with version history.
copy.detail_description: Edit the content, create versions and move it through the approval flow.
copy.delete_confirm: Delete this copy and its entire version history? This action cannot be undone.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Group pieces by event or launch. Each one has a goal, audience and context that feeds the AI.
campaigns.name: Name
campaigns.context_placeholder: Rich context that feeds the AI: offers, rules, campaign-specific tone.
campaigns.plan_locked: Campaigns aren't available on your plan.
campaigns.empty_description: Group pieces by event or launch. The campaign context feeds the AI on every generation.
campaigns.no_pieces: No pieces linked yet. Generate a copy and select this campaign.
campaigns.empty_seq_desc: Pick a channel and generate copy right here — email, WhatsApp, SMS, ads and more.
campaigns.seq_brief_ph: Offer, context, dates, tone of voice...

blog.title: Post to Blog
blog.description: Write and send straight to your WordPress blog. Save as a draft to review first, or publish right away.
blog.unconfigured_description: This workspace doesn't have a WordPress connected yet. Add the site, username and application password under Settings → Integrations.
blog.unreachable_warning: WordPress is connected, but the site isn't reachable right now. Publishing will most likely fail.
blog.field_content_placeholder: Write or paste the post copy. HTML is allowed.
blog.field_excerpt_hint: Shows up in listings and social shares. Optional.
blog.error_generic: Couldn't send this to the blog right now.
blog.field_brief_placeholder: What's the post about? e.g. how to price coloring services in 2026
blog.field_brief_hint: Guides the AI when generating the title, body and cover. Optional, but it helps a lot.
blog.cover_empty: No cover yet. Generate one with AI or upload a file.
blog.cover_needs_openai: To generate a cover with AI, add your OpenAI key. You can still upload a file.
blog.cover_bad_format: Unsupported format. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
blog.cover_too_big: Image too large. The limit is 8MB.
blog.terms_error: Couldn't load these from the blog.
blog.gen_subtitle_title: Reading your brand DNA to propose a title in your voice.
blog.gen_subtitle_content: Writing the text with your tone, your values and whatever your brand asks to avoid.
blog.gen_subtitle_cover: The image is being created and goes straight to your WordPress media library.
blog.step_title_2: Looking for an angle that hooks…
blog.step_title_3: Tuning it to the right length…
blog.step_content_5: Checking what the brand asks to avoid…
blog.gen_keep_open: Keep this window open until it finishes.
blog.gen_slow_note: Still working. Richer generations take longer — don't close the window.
blog.agent_subtitle: Plans and publishes batches of posts to your blog
blog.agent_intro: Tell me what you want to publish. I'll ask for whatever is missing — topics, how many, categories — and only generate once you confirm.
blog.agent_example_1: I want posts about hair coloring, haircuts and curly hair care
blog.agent_example_2: I need 3 posts about pricing services for salons
blog.agent_example_3: Generate content about 2026 trends for my blog
blog.agent_confirm_publish_note: The posts go live on your blog immediately.
blog.agent_confirm_draft_note: The posts land as drafts for you to review.
blog.agent_step_skipped: Not generated — plan cost limit reached.
blog.agent_running_note: Generating. You can close this: it keeps running in the background.
blog.editing_draft: You're editing a draft from My posts.
blog.posts_sync_queued: Sync queued. Posts will show up here shortly.
blog.posts_empty_description: Generate a post on the Publish tab or sync your WordPress blog.
blog.posts_sent_as_draft: Post sent to WordPress as a draft.
blog.community_not_connected: No community connected to this workspace. Connect Fluent Community under Settings → Integrations.
blog.community_space_hint: Only community spaces show up — courses and groups don't take feed posts.
blog.community_message_placeholder: Write the hook that goes to the feed…

products.title: Products
products.description: Your store catalog. Pick a product to generate copy that respects your DNA.
products.load_error: Couldn't load the catalog right now. Try reloading in a moment.
products.empty_description: Connect your WooCommerce store to pull in the catalog. The AI respects your DNA + onboarding Q&A on every description.
products.detail_description: Edit every product field and publish straight to WooCommerce. Each field has AI generation.
products.description_html_hint: Accepts HTML. Renders on the product page.

audit.title: Page analysis
audit.description: Paste any page URL — the AI returns a 0-100 score, a diagnosis per section (copy, SEO, GEO, CTA) and recommendations aligned with your DNA.
audit.ai_failed: The AI couldn't analyze this URL right now. Check the link and try again.

intelligence.title: Competitive intelligence
intelligence.description: Ingests competitor PDPs — extracts pattern, structure and strategy. NEVER copies the text: it learns the skeleton.
intelligence.empty_description: Paste competitor PDP URLs (up to 3 per ingestion). The AI returns the page structure, copy angle, apparent mechanism, highlighted assets and a competitive score.

settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.description: Everything that defines how the AI generates, who has access, active connectors and the plan in use.
settings.dna_description: Edit current + proposed. Re-extract via URL. Switch which DNA feeds the generator.
settings.team_description: Add editors and reviewers. Permissions by role (owner/admin/editor/viewer).
settings.integrations_description: WooCommerce, Shopify, Nuvemshop, Tray or CSV. Manual sync, publish back.
settings.billing_description: Current plan (entry/medium/ultra), generations this month, cost cap, billing history.
settings.auditlog_description: Every sensitive action logged with IP + user agent + diff.
settings.preferences_description: PT-BR / EN-US / ES / FR. Default model (Auto/Haiku/Sonnet/Opus) per AI action.

settingsDna.title: Brand DNA
settingsDna.description: The context that feeds every generation. Edit current + proposed and choose which one feeds the generator.
settingsDna.improve_description: The AI takes your current DNA and generates a stronger proposed version — without inventing facts. Optionally give it a direction.
settingsDna.improve_placeholder: Direction (optional): e.g. more premium, focus on urgency, more technical tone…
settingsDna.improve_done: Proposed DNA generated by the AI. See the Proposed tab.

team.title: Members & permissions
team.description: Who has access to this workspace and their roles.
team.footnote: Invites and permission changes are made by the workspace owner for security. Coming soon to the panel.

billing.title: Plan & usage
billing.description: Current plan, unlocked features and AI consumption this month.
billing.footnote: Plan changes and billing are processed by the external gateway. Contact support to upgrade.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.description: Sensitive actions logged with IP and timestamp.
auditLog.empty_description: Store connections, plan changes and sensitive actions appear here as they happen.

integrations.title: Store integrations
integrations.description: Syncs your catalog to generate descriptions in bulk. Credentials encrypted at rest.
integrations.woo_description: REST API v3 (BasicAuth with consumer key/secret). Syncs your catalog to generate descriptions in bulk.
integrations.keys_hint: Generate the keys in WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API (read permission). Credentials encrypted at rest.
integrations.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect the store? Credentials will be removed. Products already imported stay.
integrations.wp_description: Publish posts straight to your WordPress. Authenticates with an application password — never your account password, and you can revoke it anytime.
integrations.wp_app_password_hint: Generate it under Users → Profile → Application Passwords in your WordPress admin. The user needs permission to publish. Spaces are optional.
integrations.wp_test_ok: Credentials valid, with permission to publish.
integrations.openai_description: Generates post cover images with gpt-image-2 and, if you pick a model below, also writes the text instead of the default AI.
integrations.openai_api_key_hint: Create one at platform.openai.com → API keys. The key is validated before saving and stored encrypted — it never shows up again on screen.
integrations.openai_text_model_off: Don't use — keep text on the default AI
integrations.openai_text_model_hint: Applies to title, content and the blog agent. Cost counts against the same monthly workspace limit, whichever provider runs. Covers stay on gpt-image-2.
integrations.openai_model_saved: Model saved. Text now runs on OpenAI.
integrations.openai_model_off_saved: Saved. Text goes back to the default AI.
integrations.community_description: Announce your posts in the community feed. It usually lives on a different site than the blog — use the URL where Fluent Community is installed.
integrations.community_user_hint: The user must be a member of the community portal, not just a WordPress admin — the plugin rejects anyone who never joined.
integrations.community_test_ok: Connection valid. {count} space(s) available to post in.

preferences.title: Language & default model
preferences.description: Your account preferences — they apply across all workspaces.
preferences.model_hint: Auto picks the best model per task (Haiku for batches, Sonnet for copy, Opus for heavy analysis).
